div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The signal-tier appliance (16b) is a passive listener.
It receives SPAN/mirror copies of the buses, slow-telemetry
from the sensor aggregators, and read-only context from SCADA;
it never publishes GOOSE, never commands MMS, never trips a CB.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One time domain.
The substation PTP grandmaster disciplines both buses AND
the appliance's signal-plane clock (16b · origin_ns at ingest).

svg.text: Substation primary plant — IEC 61850 SAS reference (16a · pairs with 16b)
